answer: In an EigenTrust-style network, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so identities must provide sustained, honest service to build durable weight. Reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits untrusted endorsements: freshly spawned Sybils start with near-zero eigenvector centrality and, lacking trusted paths, cannot meet consensus thresholds. A knoll of colluders or plume of fabricated ratings cannot quickly erase that deficit; only credible behavior across the scoring horizon can.
